data.name: IP-Black

index.source: schmid2023, Abschn. 2 und Abb. 2 (Standardform mit B3, Satzfehler im Paper: Issue #9)

liquid_offset.source: schmid2023, Abschn. 2: nach 30 min UV gesättigt etwa 0,02 über der flüssigen Phase
liquid_offset.notes: constant over the range (assumption); the stated end points 1.505 and 1.48 of the liquid give about 0.023 (derived)

absorption.notes: extinction coefficient about 1 per mm; base not stated, taken as e (D7); liquid and cured not distinguished in the source

data.notes: visible absorption (450-650 nm) only as a figure (Abb. 1b), not tabulated; see docs/materialdaten.md
